profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer
profile.summary: Software Engineer working with Java and Python to develop APIs and Micro Services using Cloud Infrastructure.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Designed and implemented production-grade AI agent workflows using Python, CrewAi, and LangGraph to automate domain-specific business processes and multi-agent orchestration.
- Led performance testing initiatives using Gatling to validate throughput and latency under peak load conditions
- Engineered Apache Flink event processing system sustaining 10,000 events/sec that applied rule-driven logic to orchestrate downstream task generation for user workflows.
- Architected Apache Flink in-flight retry strategies and DLQ patterns to improve system resiliency, reduce data loss, and ensure reliable downstream processing.
positions.insights: Skills: Java · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · Spring Boot · Python · Gatling · Apache Flink · FastAPI

positions.title: CTY Instructor - Computer Science
positions.description: - Teaching K-12 students in Java, Python, and AP Computer Science

company.name: Johns Hopkins Center For Talented Youth (CTY)

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.locationName: New York, New York, United States
positions.description:
- Developed Microservices in Java and Python for credit card application fraud detection
- Used AWS (Lambda, ECS, EC2, DynamoDb)
- Designed event driven server less APIs (FastAPI and Lambda)
- Implemented Kafka consumers for stream based events (Java and SpringBoot)
- Wrote Unit Tests, Integration Tests (Postman), and Performance Tests (JMeter)
- Led Technical Designs and Discussions for new services and feature enhancements
- Maintained and patched security vulnerabilities (Mend)
positions.insights: Skills: Technical Discussions · Technical Presentations · Presentations · Java · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · Python (Programming Language) · MySQL · API Development · JMeter · Unit Testing · Performance Testing · JUnit · Postman · REST APIs · AWS Lambda · Code Review · Amazon Dynamodb · Splunk Enterprise · Spring Boot

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Processed post execution derivatives using Java
- Constructed data models and performing data transformations to meet client and regulatory requirements
- Modernized legacy system and data pipeline in Java
- Reconciled trade data between new and old systems
- Wrote unit tests, end to end tests, and instrumentation tests

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Spearheaded development of network monitoring, data collection, and network flow analytics with ELK stack and Docker, providing visualizations for multiple streams of data and increasing understanding of data
- Developed scripts in Ixia for full automation in traffic generation with 10 Gbps fiber lines

positions.title: Systems Engineer
positions.description: - Designed and developed Java application on Linux to query MySQL database

positions.title: Software Developer Intern
positions.description:
- Analyzed high performance computing logs using Pre-processing methods and Parallelization in Python, reducing computing time by 50%
- Handling substantial amounts of log data using Elastic, Logstash, Kibana (ELK) stack
- Contributed to CAST repository for system management of cluster-wide resources

positions.title: Web Application Developer Co-Op
positions.description:
- Developed Web application that allows customers to prepare, label, ship, track, and manage their UPS shipping needs
- Developed ASP.Net, HTML, JavaScripts, automated test scripts, and testing
- Used C#, HTML, JavaScript, and MVC design

positions.title: C and C++ Course Assistant
positions.description:
- Course assistant for Intermediate Programming in C and C++
- Assisting students new to C and C++ programming and responsible for grading

company.name: Johns Hopkins Whiting School of Engineering

positions.title: Summer Games Intern
positions.description:
- Aligned with Booz Allen's Cyber Functional Service Offerings(FSO)
- Collaborated with an intern team of six students to develop feasible software solutions and working prototypes that aid undercover field agents to drastically reduce likelihood of compromising identity

company.name: Johns Hopkins Whiting School of Engineering

positions.title: Java Course Assistant
positions.description:
- Course assistant for Introduction to Java 
- Assisted students new to Java programming and responsible for grading

positions.title: CQD Solar Cell Research Assistant
positions.description:
- Researching and testing thin film solar cells on glass substrates through a spin coating method 
- Worked with Quantum Dots to produce cheaper and cost efficient solar cells
- Trained to use Electron Beam Evaporator, Scanning Electron Microscope, and lab techniques
- Analyzed data models and set up design parameters using Lumerical Solutions to optimize nano structure geometry

positions.title: Software Development Intern
positions.description:
- Parsed over 11 different types of weather data files to organize and create comprehensive plots 
- Coded scripts that calculated a firing geometry given a target’s distance from a platform
- Parallelized scripts to optimize code run time and efficiency
- Merged scripts with military programs that took in weather data in real time
- Accessed, documented, and simulated programs on military super computer 
- Demonstrated feasibility and necessity of this program to funders and DOD

positions.title: Private Tutor
positions.description:
- Facilitated ACT tests and explanations and wrote the solutions to the answers 
- Compiled and organized all tests and solutions in organized manner in Dropbox
- Provided technological expertise in using Webex.

positions.title: Electrical Engineering Intern
positions.description:
- Operated Electron Microscope to test vacuum pump and tungsten filament
- Managed shipments and movement of parts and machines
- Installed electrical wiring with conduits and power outlets

honors.title: Dean's List
honors.description: Students who receive a semester GPA of 3.5 or higher receive Dean's List

volunteerExperiences.description:
- Served as Vice President
- Organized meetings and planned senior center trip visits and food bank events 
- Managed the group of volunteers through active demonstrations with members
- Provided food relief on missions to Mexico

- Volunteered during the President's Day of Service
- Assisted Baltimore residents with city clean up tasks
- Cleared dangerous debris pileup around abandoned housing

organizations.name: Theta Tau
organizations.description:
- Servedas Academic Chair and Scribe
- Facilitated study hours and resources needed to help members
- Organized Dropbox and Google Drive with materials of classes to assist other members 
- Recorded and filed fraternity statistic and reports to national headquarters
